local function flowerText(a1) -- Line: 510; upvalues: u0 (val); types: a1: string
    local v1 = false

    for i, j in u0.FlowerSpecies do
        if string.sub(a1, -#j) == j then
            v1 = true
            break
        end
    end

    if not v1 then
        return nil
    end

    for k, n in u0.FlowerPatterns do
        if string.sub(a1, 1, #k) == k then
            return u0.FlowerText .. n
        end
    end

    return u0.FlowerText
end

function u3.rollMortenWithPity(a1, a2, a3)

    end

    return a2 * (1 - v1) + a1.Unit * v1
end

function u0.abilityAt(a1, a2) -- Line: 592; upvalues: u0 (val); types: a1: string, a2: number

    if not v1 then
        return nil
    end

    local v2 = table.clone(v1)
    local scales = v1.scales
    local v3 = u0.effectiveness(a2)

    if scales and type(v1[scales]) == "number" then
        if scales == "cooldownSeconds" then
            v2[scales] = v1[scales] / v3
            return v2
        end

        if scales == "chance" then
            v2[scales] = (math.min(1, v1[scales] * v3))
            return v2
        end

        v2[scales] = v1[scales] * v3
    end

    return v2
end

local function percentText(a1) -- Line: 630; types: a1: number
    local v1 = a1 * 100

    if not (v1 >= 10) and v1 ~= math.floor(v1) then

local function secondsText(a1) -- Line: 637; types: a1: number
    if not (a1 >= 90) then
        if a1 == math.floor(a1) then
            return (("%* s"):format(a1))
        end

        return (("%* s"):format((string.format("%.1f", a1))))
    end

    local v1 = a1 / 60

    if v1 == math.floor(v1) then
        return (("%* min"):format(v1))
    end

    return (("%* min"):format((string.format("%.1f", v1))))
end

        v3 = v2.min + (v2.max - v2.min) * v5

        v3 = v2.min + (v2.max - v2.min) * v1 / (a6 - 1)
    end

    local v6 = u0.StatSteps[a3] or 0

    return (math.clamp(if not (v6 <= 0) then tonumber((string.format("%.6f", (math.round(v3 / v6)) * v6))) else v3, math.min(v2.min, v2.max), (math.max(v2.min, v2.max))))
end

function u0.fillMissing(a1, a2, a3, a4, a5)
    -- Line: 395
    -- upvalues: u0 (val)
    -- types: a1: table, a2: string, a3: table?, a4: function

    local v3 = false
    local v4 = nil
    local v5 = nil
    local v6, v7, v8, v9, v10 = a3, a2, a4, a5, a1

    for i, j in a1, v4, v5 do
        if not v6 or type(v6[i]) ~= "number" then
            v2[i] = j
            v3 = true
        end
    end

    if not v3 then
        return nil, false
    end

    v3 = if not v6 then {} else table.clone(v6)

    for k, n in (u0.rollStats(v2, v7, v8, v9)) do
        v3[k] = n
    end

    local v11 = true

    for m, i5 in v10 do
        v1 = u0.deriveBand(i5, m, v7)
        v1 = math.abs(v3[m] - (u0.bestValue(v1, m)))

        if v1 > 1e-09 then
            v11 = false
        end
    end

    return v3, v11
end

        return false, "You're already on this island"
    end

    if table.find(a1.members, a3) ~= nil then
        return false, "They're already on this island"
    end

    if table.find(a1.invites, a3) ~= nil then
        return false, "They already have an invite"
    end

    if a5 <= #a1.invites then
        return false, "Too many invites out. Cancel one first."
    end

    if a4 <= u0.seatsTaken(a1) then
        return false, (("This island is full (%*)"):format(a4))
    end

    return true, nil
end

function u0.canAccept(a1, a2, a3) -- Line: 152; types: a1: table, a2: number, a3: number
    if table.find(a1.members, a2) ~= nil then
        return false, "You're already on this island"
    end

    if not (table.find(a1.invites, a2) ~= nil) then
        return false, "That invite is no longer open"
    end

    if a3 <= #a1.members then
        return false, "That island filled up"
    end

    return true, nil
end

function u0.canCancel(a1, a2, a3) -- Line: 165; upvalues: u0 (val); types: a1: table, a2: number, a3: number
    if not u0.isOwner(a1, a2) then
        return false, "Only the owner can cancel invites"
    end

    if not (table.find(a1.invites, a3) ~= nil) then
        return false, "There's no invite to cancel"
    end

    return true, nil
end

function u0.canRemove(a1, a2, a3) -- Line: 177; types: a1: table, a2: number, a3: number
    if a3 == a1.owner then
        return false, "The owner can't be removed"
    end

    if not (table.find(a1.members, a3) ~= nil) then
        return false, "They aren't on this island"
    end

    if a2 ~= a1.owner and a2 ~= a3 then
        return false, "Only the owner can remove someone"
    end

    return true, nil
end

function u0.withMember(a1, a2) -- Line: 197; types: a1: table, a2: number
    local v1 = table.clone(a1.members)

    if not (table.find(v1, a2) ~= nil) then
        table.insert(v1, a2)
    end

    local v2 = {}

    for i, j in a1.invites do
        if j ~= a2 then
            table.insert(v2, j)
        end
    end

    return {owner = a1.owner, name = a1.name, members = v1, invites = v2}
end

function u0.withoutMember(a1, a2) -- Line: 211; types: a1: table, a2: number
    local v1 = {}

    for i, j in a1.members do
        if j ~= a2 then
            table.insert(v1, j)
        end
    end

    return {
        owner = a1.owner,
        name = a1.name,
        members = v1,
        invites = table.clone(a1.invites),
    }
end

function u0.withInvite(a1, a2) -- Line: 221; types: a1: table, a2: number
    local v1 = table.clone(a1.invites)

    if not (table.find(v1, a2) ~= nil) and not (table.find(a1.members, a2) ~= nil) then
        table.insert(v1, a2)
    end

    return {
        owner = a1.owner,
        name = a1.name,
        members = table.clone(a1.members),
        invites = v1,
    }
end

function u0.isInvited(a1, a2) -- Line: 231; types: a1: table, a2: number
    return table.find(a1.invites, a2) ~= nil
end

function u0.withoutInvite(a1, a2) -- Line: 235; types: a1: table, a2: number
    local v1 = {}

    for i, j in a1.invites do
        if j ~= a2 then
            table.insert(v1, j)
        end
    end

    return {
        owner = a1.owner,
        name = a1.name,
        members = table.clone(a1.members),
        invites = v1,
    }
end

############################################################
SCRIPT NUMBER: 230
NAME: DisplayAccepts
CLASS: ModuleScript
PATH: ReplicatedStorage.Shared.DisplayAccepts
############################################################

EXTRACTION STATUS: SUCCESS
SOURCE LENGTH: 1107 characters

-- Script path: game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.DisplayAccepts
-- Decompile time: 0.71 ms

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)
return {
    takes = function(a1, a2) -- Line: 11; upvalues: Config (val); types: a1: string?, a2: string
        local v1

        if a1 == nil then
            return true
        end

        if a1 == "Weapon" then
            v1 = true

            if Config.Weapon.Weapons[a2] == nil then
                v1 = Config.Tool.Tools[a2] ~= nil
            end

            return v1
        end

        if a1 == "Armor" then
            v1 = Config.Wearable.slotOf(a2)
            local v2 = false

            if v1 ~= nil then
                v2 = Config.Wearable.isEnabled(v1)
            end

            return v2
        end

        if a1 == "Shiny" then
            return Config.Shiny.isShiny(a2)
        end

        if a1 == "Flower" then
            return Config.Flower.isFlower(a2)
        end

        if a1 == "Food" then
            return Config.Food.isFood(a2) and Config.Recipe.Food[a2] ~= nil
        end

        return false
    end,
}

function u95:GamepadZoomPress() -- Line: 457; upvalues: LocalPlayer (val)
    local CameraMinZoomDistance
    local CameraToSubjectDistance = self:GetCameraToSubjectDistance()
    local CameraMaxZoomDistance = LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance

    for i = #self.gamepadZoomLevels, 1, -1 do
        CameraMinZoomDistance = self.gamepadZoomLevels[i]

        if not (CameraMaxZoomDistance < CameraMinZoomDistance) then
            if CameraMinZoomDistance < LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance then
                CameraMinZoomDistance = LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance

                if CameraMaxZoomDistance == CameraMinZoomDistance then
                    break
                end
            end

            if CameraMinZoomDistance + (CameraMaxZoomDistance - CameraMinZoomDistance) / 2
                < CameraToSubjectDistance then
                self:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(CameraMinZoomDistance)
                return
            end

            CameraMaxZoomDistance = CameraMinZoomDistance
        end
    end

    self:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(self.gamepadZoomLevels[#self.gamepadZoomLevels])
end

function u16.ConvertCameraModeEnumToStandard(a1) -- Line: 192
    if a1 == Enum.TouchCameraMovementMode.Default then
        return Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Follow
    end

    if a1 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Default then
        return Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic
    end

    if a1 ~= Enum.TouchCameraMovementMode.Classic
        and a1 ~= Enum.DevTouchCameraMovementMode.Classic
        and a1 ~= Enum.DevComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic
        and a1 ~= Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic then
        if a1 ~= Enum.TouchCameraMovementMode.Follow
            and a1 ~= Enum.DevTouchCameraMovementMode.Follow
            and a1 ~= Enum.DevComputerCameraMovementMode.Follow
            and a1 ~= Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Follow then
            if a1 ~= Enum.TouchCameraMovementMode.Orbital
                and a1 ~= Enum.DevTouchCameraMovementMode.Orbital
                and a1 ~= Enum.DevComputerCameraMovementMode.Orbital
                and a1 ~= Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Orbital then
                if a1 ~= Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.CameraToggle
                    and a1 ~= Enum.DevComputerCameraMovementMode.CameraToggle then
                    if a1 ~= Enum.DevTouchCameraMovementMode.UserChoice
                        and a1 ~= Enum.DevComputerCameraMovementMode.UserChoice then
                        return Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic
                    end

                    return Enum.DevComputerCameraMovementMode.UserChoice
                end

                return Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.CameraToggle
            end

            return Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Orbital
        end

        return Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Follow
    end

function u0:restoreSimulatedRotation() -- Line: 250

    if renderedRotationOverride.rootPart.Parent ~= nil then

function u0:applyRenderedRotation() -- Line: 261; upvalues: Workspace (val)
    local CurrentCamera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local humanoid = self.humanoid
    local RootPart = humanoid and humanoid.RootPart

    if CurrentCamera ~= nil
        and RootPart ~= nil
        and not humanoid.Sit
        and humanoid.SeatPart == nil
        and not RootPart:IsGrounded()
        and (humanoid:GetState()) ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
        local LookVector = CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
        local v1 = Vector3.new(LookVector.X, 0, LookVector.Z)

        if v1.Magnitude < 0.001 then
            return
        end

        if self.renderedRotationOverride ~= nil
            and self.renderedRotationOverride.rootPart ~= RootPart then
            self:restoreSimulatedRotation()
        end

        if self.renderedRotationOverride == nil then
            self.renderedRotationOverride = {rootPart = RootPart, simulatedRotation = RootPart.CFrame.Rotation}
        end

        local Position = RootPart.CFrame.Position
        RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Position, Position + v1)
    end
end

local function upgradeEntries(a1) -- Line: 1013

    end

        v1,
        function(a1, a2) -- Line: 1033

local function ago(a1) -- Line: 113; types: a1: number
    local v1 = math.max(0, (os.time()) - a1)

    if v1 < 60 then
        return "just now"
    end

    local v2 = math.floor(v1 / 60)

    if v2 < 60 then
        return (("%*m ago"):format(v2))
    end

    v1 = math.floor(v2 / 60)

    if v1 < 24 then
        return (("%*h ago"):format(v1))
    end

    v2 = math.floor(v1 / 24)

    if v2 < 7 then
        return (("%*d ago"):format(v2))
    end

    return (("%*w ago"):format((math.floor(v2 / 7))))
end
